crossRefs.note: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
“Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is…
God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

translations.web: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
translations.bsb: Do you have an arm like God’s? Can you thunder with a voice like His?
translations.kjv: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice
translations.asv: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
